references.text: Nadab and Abihu each took their own fire pan (maktot), the same implement that Korah and his company were instructed to take
The fire pan (makta) was used to carry glowing coals and incense before the Lord
Continuation of the instruction where each man took his fire pan with fire and incense
The fire pans of those who died were beaten into plates for the altar, as a reminder that no outsider should burn incense before the Lord
Recap of Korah's rebellion and his congregation gathering against Moses and Aaron
Instruction to make fire pans (maktot) of bronze as an implement for the altar
